entities.summary: Sibusiso Moyo (b. 1960, Mberengwa District) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Mberengwa District and Zimbabwe. Known in the fields of zimbabwe, military leaders & commanders, africa.
